items.title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.
